name: wup_known_fires_seed
description: Starter catalog of documented wildfires in the six WUPPDR counties for the explorer's fire checks. Add more (NIFC/WFIGS/InFORM, MTBS, Michigan DNR exports) with Import in the Fires tab. Times are UTC; date-only records have date_only=true.

properties.name: Pinery Fire
properties.source: Michigan DNR / NIFC records (All_Wildfires_in_Michigan_and_more_EXCEL.xlsx, FireDiscov / IncidentSi)
properties.notes: Largest WUP fire > 100 ac with valid coordinates in that spreadsheet; the project's event-window case study.

reference.label: Classic daily FWI on the discovery day
reference.basis: Your earlier real-AORC run (xclim cffwis, origin pixel). That run took noon as 18Z (13:00 EST) and started 85/6/15 on 2009-05-13; this tool uses 12:00 LST (17Z) and spin-up, so a few units of difference are expected.

reference.label: Hourly FWI2025 at 18Z on the discovery day
reference.basis: Your earlier real-AORC run with the official cffdrs-ng hFWI (nearest pixel of its 8-cell stride sample, 46.732 N 88.402 W, ~2.9 km south of the origin; cold start 2009-05-13). Same equations as this tool's cffdrs-ng mode; start-up differs.

reference.label: Hourly FWI2025 evening peak on the discovery day
reference.basis: Same earlier run and pixel: peak 20.5 at 21Z and 23Z.

properties.name: Summit Lake Fire
properties.notes: McCormick Wilderness (Ottawa NF), spotted by aircraft; heavy dead and downed fuels near Evergreen Lake; ~225 ac by 2024-10-23 (WNMU, Bridge Michigan).

properties.name: Craig Lake 1
properties.source: NIFC WFIGS Incident Locations (no point of origin published yet)
properties.notes: North of Craig Lake State Park; ~400 ac and 25% contained on 2026-10-12 (FOX 11). Set its location on the map to check it. AORC may not reach this date yet.
